title: Multiplying Fractions
intro: Multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators. An area model shows a fraction of another fraction. Simplify the result.
html:
Multiplying Fractions

Multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators. An area model shows a fraction of another fraction. Simplify the result.

Worked example

2/3 × 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2. In a rectangle split into 12 equal parts, the overlapping region covers 6 parts.

Watch out

Do not add denominators or expect multiplication always to make a number larger.
